title: Chassidus Made Real
author: Rabbi Sholom Kesselman
description:
A bi-weekly program (a discussion, shiur, and farbrengen, all in one) in which ideas of Chassidus will be explored and taught in a "real" way.

The word “real” here has a twofold meaning.

First, real Limmud Hachassidus. 

Topics will be learned and understood in a pure, authentic Chassidic style. Not watered down, altered, or dressed down using language and values that are foreign to Chassidus.

And second, real life. 

The topics will be learned and understood in a way that is practical, meaningful, real, and capable of changing the way we live. Chassidus cannot remain in the clouds; it must speak to us as human beings living in olam hazeh. It must transform, elevate, and infuse our daily lives and Avodas Hashem with chayus, bittul, meaning, authenticity and clarity.

title: Good News
author: Sarah Saasha
description:
Every day, we hear about the things going wrong in the world. We hear about conflict, disasters, problems and uncertainty. And while those stories matter, they can sometimes make it easy to overlook the good things happening around us.

So this podcast is a chance to pause for a moment — to celebrate the progress, kindness and positive change that often go unnoticed

Episodes will air every Friday at 19:00 hours

title: Lucky Vibes
author: Jutta & Jamie Schneider
description: Real estate is completely unhinged — and that’s exactly why Lucky Vibes exists. Jamie and Jutta of Lucky Palms Realty talk about what really happens behind the scenes: buyers who disappear, sellers stuck on price, inspection drama, contracts, negotiations, market reality, and the human side of every deal. Real estate, real life, and real talk — without the Instagram filter.

title: NPUC Ministerial Convention
author: North Pacific Union Conference
description:
Refreshed. Refilled. Ready.

Experience the sermons from “It’s Beginning to Rain,” the North Pacific Union’s 2026 Ministerial Convention at Walla Walla University.

Created for pastors, their families, and ministry leaders, this collection celebrates the Holy Spirit’s work in our churches and communities. These messages invite us to seek God’s guidance, find renewal in His presence, and strengthen our commitment to helping people follow Jesus.

title: Clash Cast
author: PPJ
description:
Welcome to Clash Cast —the podcast covering the premier team disc golf challenge across the Southeast. Team disc golf hits different than solo play, and we’re here to break down all of it. Every episode, we dig into regional team match-ups, course strategy for local stops across the coastal Carolinas, format rules, and practical takeaways to help your crew score more points on tournament weekend.


Whether you’re on the roster competing for the trophy, following your local club’s run, or looking to sharpen your doubles and team strategy, tune in for honest breakdowns, match recaps, and down-to-earth talk from around the region.

Hit subscribe, rally your squad, and let’s throw.

title: The Waterborne Podcast
author: Shafiq
description: The Waterborne Podcast is an analytical deep dive into high-performance swimming biomechanics, stroke efficiency, physiological conditioning, and race strategy. From breaking down drag-reduction physics and high elbow catch mechanics to mastering underwater dolphin kicks, flip turn acceleration, and taper cycles, we explore the science of speed in the water. Fully compliant with Spreaker content guidelines and distribution policies, this show delivers clear, structured, and actionable guidance for swimmers, triathletes, and aquatic coaches worldwide.

title: The Future of Hiring: Conversations Powered by Radancy
author: Radancy
description:
The Future of Hiring: Conversations Powered by Radancy explores the ideas, innovations and people shaping what’s next in talent acquisition.

Hosted by Steven Ehrlich, each episode brings together leaders and thinkers from across the talent acquisition spectrum and around the world for candid conversations about the forces transforming how organizations attract, engage and hire talent.

From AI and emerging technology to employer brand, candidate experience, skills, culture and the changing role of recruiters, we go beyond the buzzwords to explore what’s actually changing, what matters, and what the future of hiring might look like.

Smart people. Different perspectives. Real conversations about what comes next.

title: goo adventures
author: the goo collection
description:
Explore the Goo Universe with Dragoo, Honeygoo and Unigoo, as they take you on all sorts of magical adventures! 🌟
Short educational stories where you can learn social and emotional skills through sound & play. 
Play this for your little ones as a bed time story, road entertainment 🚗, or at home for screen-free fun!
To learn more about the Goo Universe and our mission, visit thegoocollection.com

title: The Truth They Buried
author: Dr. Nzinga cates
description: Some stories were buried. It’s time to dig them up. 🖤🎙️ The Truth They Buried explores lesser-known serial killers while centering the victims—not the killers. I also unpack listener stories, questions, and scenarios involving narcissistic parents, toxic relationships, gaslighting, manipulation, family drama, and more. Serious, funny, messy, or wild—I want to hear it. 📩 Submit anonymously: tttbcates@gmail.com. Not every monster leaves fingerprints.

title: TalkEverythingAndExtraWithItunu
author: Itunu
description: Every gist and happens from sweet, embarrassing, hot and spicy, subtle and relatable experience. Say cruise and relaxing on Talk Everything and Extra with Itunu.

title: Between us and our bodies
author: Grace
description:
Between Us & Our Bodies 
Welcome to Between Us & Our Bodies- a space for honest conversations about health, relationships, love, sex, and everything in between.
We talk about the things we’re often too shy to ask, from sexual and reproductive health to dating, boundaries, body changes, emotional wellbeing, and relationships.
Real conversations. Honest questions. No judgment. 
Between Us & Our Bodies — because the conversations that matter shouldn’t be the ones we’re afraid to have.

title: Good Evening, Hollywood!
author: Make It Hollywood
description:
The award went to who? What happens during the commericals? What gifts do the celebs take home? And what happens when the custom gown won’t zip six hours before the carpet?
Good Evening, Hollywood! is the awards-season podcast for everyone who watches the show with one eye on the group chat. Entertainment reporter Rae Williams dishes everything from the red carpets and FYC campaigns to how the trophies get made and who gets to take them home. 
Tune in weekly as we get into the speeches, surprises, and people who make entertainment’s biggest nights happen.

title: Heavy Lifting & Light Banter
author: the fitness cult
description: Join ACE-certified trainer Kailey Vieweg Rodriguez and her witty, "layman" partner Carlos Rodriguez for real talk on functional fitness. Whether you're navigating the chaos of postpartum or the shift into perimenopause, we’re here to help you master your body’s biggest hormonal transitions. No toxic "aesthetic" trends; just science-backed strength to help you thrive in real life. Warm, relatable, and expertly guided, we make fitness the best part of your day. Join the cult of functional movement at thefitcult.com.

title: Soccer Tactical Breakdown
author: Shakeel
description: Soccer Tactical Breakdown is an analytical podcast dedicated strictly to breaking down modern soccer strategy, pitch geometry, player positioning, and match dynamics. From analyzing high-press Gegenpressing triggers and inverted full-back roles to build-up structures against deep-lying low blocks, we dissect the strategic chess match taking place on the soccer pitch. Fully compliant with Spreaker content guidelines and distribution policies, this show delivers clear, structured, and insightful commentary for coaches, players, and passionate soccer fans worldwide.

title: TRUE CRIME FACTORY
author: Tijov
description: Welcome to True Crime Factory, a channel dedicated to the darkest and most intriguing true crime stories from around the world. Discover real criminal cases, unsolved mysteries, missing persons, shocking investigations, notorious criminals, courtroom stories, and cases that continue to raise unanswered questions. Each episode explores the facts, evidence, timelines, and mysteries behind real cases. Our goal is to tell these stories in a clear, respectful, and engaging way while remembering the real people affected by these tragedies. Subscribe to True Crime Factory and follow the stories that made headlines, changed investigations, and left the world searching for answers.

I get even” and the surprising context behind an interview answer that quickly became memorable.A fascinating episode about interviews, unexpected answers, human behavior, and the moments that leave a lasting impression.

title: The Vehicle Protection Guide
author: Gleamworks Ceramic
description:
The Vehicle Protection Guide explores practical ways to protect and maintain your vehicle’s exterior. Each episode explains topics such as paint protection film, ceramic coatings, detailing, paint care and common causes of exterior damage in clear, straightforward language.
Learn more: https://gleamworksceramic.ca/
Created for drivers who want to better understand vehicle protection options and make informed decisions about maintaining their cars in Vancouver and the Lower Mainland.

title: Training in Righteousness
author: pastorhill307
description: "All Scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for training in righteousness, that the man of God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work" (2 Timothy 3:16-17). Training in Righteousness is a recording of daily sermons and a weekly Bible Study by LCMS Pastor Andrew Hill. Listen in as we digest the Holy Scriptures together.

title: The Global HealthRoom
author: Val
description:
The Global HealthRoom explores the intersection of health, science, innovation, and humanity.

Each episode brings together diverse voices and perspectives to discuss the challenges and opportunities shaping our world—from global health and health disparities to medicine, mental health, technology, education, and social impact.

We believe that conversations have the power to challenge perspectives, inspire ideas, and create meaningful change.

This is a space to learn, ask difficult questions, discover new perspectives, and connect with the people working to build a healthier and more equitable future.

author: Spencer
description: Endurance Decoded is an analytical podcast dedicated to long-distance running science, training methodologies, and race strategy. From low-intensity Zone 2 cardio base building and VO2 max interval workouts to running economy, stride mechanics, and race-day fuel pacing, we dissect the physiological and mental factors that build elite endurance. Fully compliant with Spreaker content guidelines and distribution policies, this show delivers clear, evidence-based guidance for runners, coaches, and endurance athletes striving for personal bests.

description: Jack Tame and Tova O'Brien are doing a podcast. Each week they're joined by political experts and insiders to unpack the week's biggest stories and break down what they mean for New Zealanders. Any questions, comments or reckons, get in touch - tameandtova@tvnz.co.nz

title: Talking About Talent
author: American Association of Community Colleges
description: Talking About Talent is hosted by Dr. DeRionne Pollard featuring conversations about community colleges and the national talent pipeline. Thought leaders, practitioners, and government officials explore some of higher education's most pressing questions, from expanding economic mobility and strengthening the workforce to higher education's role in the public good, civic education, and building resilient communities.

title: Inhumam Podcast
author: dexaye
description: Welcome to Inhuman Podcast, where we explore the darkest and most disturbing true crime cases from around the world. Each episode dives deep into real criminal investigations, shocking murders, unsolved mysteries, disappearances, and the twisted minds behind them. Through detailed storytelling, factual research, and gripping narratives, we uncover the events, evidence, and human stories that continue to fascinate and haunt us. Whether it's a notorious serial killer, a baffling cold case, or a crime that changed a community forever, Inhuman Podcast brings you the truth behind the headlines. Listener discretion is advised. Some episodes contain descriptions of violence, criminal acts, and disturbing content that may not be suitable for all audiences. New episodes released regularly. Subscribe and join us as we uncover the most inhuman crimes ever committed.

title: Church Revive Network
author: Church Revive Network
description: A podcast for church ministry leaders that helps churches and their leaders maximize their God-given potential to strengthen and lead healthy churches.

title: Reparations Nation Podcast
author: Kevin
description:
Hosted by Rev. Dr. Kevin C. Peterson, Reparations Nation is a podcast exploring the people, policies, history, faith, and ideas shaping the movement for reparations and a more just democratic future.

Through thoughtful conversations with leaders, scholars, advocates, faith voices, organizers, and change-makers from the United States and around the world, Rev. Peterson examines what repair really means—and what it takes to move from conversation to action.

From racial justice and restorative justice to democracy, public policy, reconciliation, and community transformation, Reparations Nation goes beyond the headlines to ask the deeper questions about where we have been, where we are, and where we must go next.

People. Policy. Power. Possibility.

Listen. Learn. Engage. Join the conversation.

title: Appalachian Hope: Helpers & Healing After Helene
author: Aaron Scott-Unleash Generosity
description: Unleash Generosity, in partnership with Create Appalachia, features firsthand accounts of survivors, emergency responders, elected officials, churches, non-profit organizations , businesses, and neighbors who responded to Hurricane Helene that impacted upper Northeast Tennessee on September 27, 2024.  Episodes will focus on the day of the disaster up to the 2 year mark of the long-term recovery process.

description: This seven part series looks at the Biblical Reasons I believe women are free to serve alongside men in leadership and teaching in our Churches.

title: Hope Westminster
author: Hope Community Church Westminster
description: Welcome to Hope Community Church Westminster’s Podcast. We are glad you are here, we pray that these sermons bless you and give you encouragement in your daily walk with Jesus. You are loved, You are worthy.

title: Soul to Soul with Gillian McMichael
author: Gillian McMichael
description:
Conversations from the heart of the healer’s path.

Hosted by Soul Healer, ICF Master Coach and best-selling author Gillian McMichael, Soul to Soul is a space for the soul-led and the called. For those who feel drawn to heal, to guide others, and to live a life shaped from the inside out.

In each new episode, Gillian sits down, soul to soul, with healers, practitioners and seekers to explore the real journey of stepping into this work. The doubt and the calling. The grief and the awakening. The healing that changes us, and what it truly means to come home to yourself before helping others do the same.

Alongside these conversations, you’ll find Gillian’s earlier episodes exploring healing, self-trust, forgiveness, alignment and the journey back to self - the inner work that forms such an important part of the healer’s path.

Whether you’re already walking this path or simply feeling the first pull towards it, pull up a chair.

These are conversations about healing, becoming, and answering the call.

*Previously Full Circle: Finding Your Way Home.

title: City On The Hill Podcast
author: City On The Hill
description:
Welcome to the City On The Hill Podcast, where faith meets everyday life and the Word of God continues beyond Sunday morning.

You’re listening to a replay of a powerful message from City On The Hill. Whether you’re hearing it for the first time or coming back for another listen, we pray this Word encourages you, challenges you, and helps you grow in your walk with God.

Be sure to follow the podcast, share this message with someone who needs it, and stay connected with City On The Hill.

Now, get ready to receive the Word. Here’s today’s sermon.

title: Deep Bible Stories
author: dopava
description: Deep Bible Stories is where Christians come to go deeper into Scripture — book by book, chapter by chapter, line by line. Every week we publish new teachings on the books of the Bible, the life of Christ, the prophets, the writings, and the truths most believers were never taught.

title: History's Most Remarkable Crimes
author: PodcastsYouNeedToHear
description:
History’s Most Remarkable Crimes explores the fascinating stories behind history’s most notorious murders, daring heists, ingenious scams, unsolved mysteries, and extraordinary investigations.
Each episode brings a remarkable case to life, examining what happened, the evidence, the people involved, and the lasting impact on society. Discover the truth behind the crimes that shocked the world—and the mysteries that still refuse to be solved.
This podcast uses synthetic voice and is researched from historical sources.

title: Entérate BB con Gati
author: Gati
description:
Entérate BB — Breaking Bilingual Bochinche con Gati.
News, culture, politics y el bochinche que necesitas para entender qué está pasando — and why it matters. Gati breaks down the headlines in English, español y Spanglish, with humor, context, receipts and zero patience for nonsense. 
From free speech and climate to immigration, history, internet madness and the stories detrás de los titulares, Entérate BB makes the news easier to understand — without making it boring. 
Infórmate. Respira. Participa. Y sí… vota.
New episodes in English, español y todo lo que pasa in between.

title: Puck Breakdown: Inside the Rink
author: Tessa
description: Puck Breakdown: Inside the Rink is an analytical hockey podcast covering high-level game strategy, modern team systems, power play structures, and NHL developments. From breaking down zone entries and neutral zone forechecking to analyzing goaltending biomechanics and front-office roster construction, we deliver in-depth hockey journalism and tactical analysis. Fully compliant with Spreaker content guidelines and distribution policies, this show offers clear, structured, and insightful commentary for fans, coaches, and players who want to understand the game beneath the surface.

title: UL Science and Engineering Postgraduate Pathways
author: Science and Engineering University of Limerick
description:
In this video podcast series we get "under the hood" of some of the most innovative postgraduate education programmes in UL's Faculty of Science & Engineering. Hear from Course Directors and graduates to find out about the programmes and how graduates felt they benefited from them. 
Hosted by Dermot Comerford and Produced by Dermot Comerford and Kyle Christy, with thanks to the Glucksman Library at University of Limerick.

title: Shadow Files True Crime
author: tidesi
description:
Welcome to Shadow Files, a podcast exploring the darkest mysteries, chilling true crime cases, unexplained disappearances, forgotten investigations, and untold stories that continue to haunt the world.
Each episode takes you deep into mysterious cases, hidden details, strange events, and stories that deserve to be remembered. From unsolved crimes to shocking disappearances and secrets buried in the past, Shadow Files searches for the truth behind the stories that remain in the shadows.

title: Love Food Love Life
author: Deeti Vyas Beghin
description: Welcome to Love Food, Love Life, the podcast that’s all about celebrating the simple pleasures of great food, meaningful connections, and living a vibrant life. Whether you’re a passionate home cook, a foodie, wants to learn more about where our food comes from or just someone who loves to savor life’s best moments, this podcast is for you! Through stories, recipes, and practical tips, Love Food, Love Life will remind you that food isn’t just about fuel; it’s about joy, connection, and living life to the fullest.

description: Because life makes a lot more sense after coffee... or at least it feels like it does.

author: Young Alberta
description: On our podcast we connect with young adults across Alberta who are making a difference in their community, and share the context young people need to navigate current issues.

title: The Pure Strike: Golf Unlocked
author: Scarlett
description: The Pure Strike: Golf Unlocked is an analytical golf podcast designed for golfers who want to break down swing mechanics, master course strategy, and understand equipment technology. From low-handicap swing principles and compression techniques to mental course management and tour level fitting secrets, we explore every dimension of the game. Fully compliant with Spreaker content standards and distribution policies, this show offers clear, actionable, and structured golf instruction and equipment journalism for players dedicated to improving their game.

title: the Bible stories
author: Bible story
description:
Welcome to Bible Story Wonders, a peaceful podcast where timeless Bible stories come to life through inspiring storytelling, gentle narration, and meaningful lessons. ✨📖
Journey through the stories of the Bible, discover powerful messages of faith, hope, courage, love, and forgiveness, and explore the lives of biblical characters in a relaxing and engaging way. Whether you’re listening before bedtime, during a quiet moment, or simply looking to reconnect with Scripture, our stories are created to bring peace, reflection, and inspiration.

title: Jett 360 - Presented by Jett Title
author: Jett Title
description:
Welcome to The Jett 360 Podcast, where real people talk real estate, brought to you by Jett Title, a proudly veteran-owned title company serving Kentucky. 
This podcast is all about the people, partnerships, and stories that help turn houses into homes. In each episode, we sit down with the professionals, business owners, and community leaders who help people navigate one of life's biggest milestones—finding a place to call home. 
Whether you're in the real estate industry, buying a home, or simply enjoy conversations with great people, we hope you find something valuable in every episode.

title: Paws to Encourage
author: Bobby Kissner
description:
Paws to Encourage is about facing hard things, refusing to give up, and the dogs that stand beside us through it all.
Hosted by BK (Bobby Kissner) and his service dog, Maverick, the show features real conversations with Veterans, first responders, athletes, leaders, and everyday people who have been knocked down by life and found a way forward.
BK knows that struggle firsthand. Alongside his service dog, Maverick, he brings an unfiltered perspective to conversations about PTSD, mental health, setbacks, resilience, and the battles people often fight without anyone else knowing.
Brought to you by The Hero Company, you'll also hear incredible stories about service dogs, the human-dog bond, and how having a loyal companion by your side can restore independence, provide purpose, and sometimes even save a life.
This isn't about pretending the hard days don't happen. It's about what you do next.
You got this. You can do it. We're cheering you on.

author: guruscribe

In this episode, we talk about how modern transcription tools are changing everyday workflows for podcasters, journalists, students, researchers, marketers, agencies, business teams, and content creators who work with recorded conversations, interviews, webinars, meetings, lectures, and media files.

title: The Wild Ways: Coffee, Chaos, And Compassion
author: The WildWays Foundation
description:
This isn’t a podcast about perfect parenting. It’s about neurodivergence as it is actually lived, the messy bits, the misunderstood bits, and the moments that make you laugh, cry, rage or reach for another coffee.
Suzan Issa and Rosalind Walker talk honestly about PDA, burnout, education, relationships, parenting and what happens when life doesn’t fit neatly into the usual boxes.
Expect real stories, lived experience, brilliant guests, difficult conversations, plenty of compassion and no shame or blame. Sometimes the most powerful thing we can do is simply talk honestly about real life.

title: The Room

description: Where mothers meet to share their inner world.

title: Stories from the Overworld - A Video Game Short-Story Podcast
author: TheGoatedGamer and Elle Mack
description:
Welcome to Stories from the Overworld hosted by video game loving fan, Cedar, and his mom. This is a podcast all about video games. 
We will discuss topics like: what he and his guests have been doing in Minecraft (or just games they play in general), how to make things in games, and, of course, any new news video game developers have to offer!
The podcast is kid friendly. Though it is recommended for people who play video games, anyone can listen to it!
Enjoy the stories that we will have at the start of almost every episode! All written by the host or found on the Minecraft Creepypasta Wiki.

author: MrScaryStories

title: The Herd of Turtles
author: Brent Krizo
description: Join host Brent Krizo as he interviews people who have decided to go their own route and are pursuing what truly makes them happy with the intention to inspire you to make your own path through life. We explore inspiring stories with a focus on travel, active lifestyles, family and how they are able to make it all work. Gone are the days of working 30 years and retiring with a gold watch and a pension. More people are finding ways to pursue their passions at an earlier age with non-location based careers that allow them to live a life that others can only dream about. Learn the success the hacks and the challenges that they have faced to help you live a life to get you excited every morning.

title: DITCH THE GLITCH - PODCAST
author: Adam Gripenblom

A different kind of podcast about the glitches we encounter at work, in life, and within ourselves.

title: In Bed With Eden
author: Eden Viridian
description:
They say you should never kiss and tell...
But I don't like being told what to do. And there are some stories that are too important to keep behind closed doors. Welcome to In Bed with Eden, the podcast where we pull beack the covers on the adult industry and give a voice to the people behind the profession. We're breaking down stigma, and having conversations that are inclusive of all industry workers. Expect some stories to leave you speechless, and others to leave you in stitches. The kind of dark humour that not everyone will get, but everyone is welcome. So, come and jump into bed with me, Eden.

title: Her AI Brief: Daily AI News for Women
author: Marielle Rice / FutHer AI
description: Her AI Brief is a daily podcast that keeps women current on AI in about five minutes. Hosted by Marielle Rice of FutHer AI and PowerHouse Women Real Estate Investing. Each episode covers the AI news that matters for entrepreneurs and investors, practical ways women and moms are using AI in daily life, health, and family, plus honest coverage of AI regulation, privacy, and ethics. No hype, no jargon. Just what you need to know, every weekday morning. Dictated by Marielle's AI twin.

title: Bones
author: Lo Raito
description:
Bones tells the true stories written in human remains. Each episode, host Nirob takes one famous find — the Iceman found melting out of an alpine glacier, a plague pit unearthed beneath a London street, a king discovered under a city car park, the mass graves of a battle and a frozen army, the body of a girl in the ruins of a starving colony — and rebuilds it: the moment of the discovery, the scientists who examined the remains, the clues the bones carried, and the truth about the life and the death that they finally told.

From the oldest murder in the world to the forensic science that identifies the missing soldiers of a modern war, Bones is the story of the dead and of the living who read them. Meticulously researched, clear about the science of osteology and archaeology, and honest about the difference between the stories we tell about the dead and the evidence the bones themselves provide. Clean and suitable for all ages. A new find every week

title: Badgers Camp Confidential
author: Fox Sports 1070 (WTSO-AM)
description: Fox Sports 1070 The Game & 1310 WIBA Sports Director Doug Russell is covering Badgers camp all month long. Every Tuesday and Thursday at 5:00pm through the run of camp, join Doug on Fox Sports 1070 for Camp Confidential!

title: Voodoo Biomechanics
author: Ray Anthony, FRCPodS
description:
Voodoo Biomechanics -- where science meets skepticism,and tradition gets a hard reboot. Ray Anthony presents content to explore the cutting edge of podiatric biomechanics—including his SHIFT PROJECT for foot orthotic therapy. This is where biomechanics gets interrogated, deconstructed, and reimagined. No myths. No magic. Just data-driven disruption. All podcasts are prepared by Ray Anthony and presented  using AI-generated voices from Google NotebookLM.
Contact: ray@voodoobiomechanics.com

title: The Storage Sessions
author: YSN
description:
Welcome to The Storage Sessions, brought to you by The Young Storage Network. .
The YSN recognises and supports youth in the industry with the idea being for a group of under 40s to get together to network and share ideas.

title: Banshee Broadcasts
author: Banshee Broadcasts
description: Banshee Broadcasts focused on emergency broadcasts, final messages, and real-time survival stories. Every episode unfolds as a live signal, grounded, tense, and stripped of filler. These are creepypasta stories told through static, interruption, and human voices trying to be heard before the signal drops. New broadcasts arrive regularly. Tune in and stay alert.

title: Can We Actually Talk About this?
author: Kirsty Davies & Jessica Johnson
description:
Can We Actually Talk About This? is the podcast where we talk about all the things women think about, laugh about, worry about… but don’t always say out loud. 👀


From sex, self-pleasure, dating and relationships to body confidence, getting older, friendships, people pleasing and everything in between - nothing is off the table.


Expect honest conversations, plenty of laughs, the occasional rant and absolutely no pretending we’ve got it all figured out.


We’ll also be trying, testing and reviewing some of the things we talk about - from sex toys and products to experiences that push us outside our comfort zones - and giving you our completely honest verdicts. 😈


Each episode we’ll share what we’re grateful for, get something off our chest with Rant of the Week, dive into Today’s Taboo, and set ourselves a Little Win that we have to complete before the next episode.

Two women. Real conversations. No judgement. Probably too much information. 😂

Sometimes the conversation begins with one subject and ends somewhere no one expected. A family story can uncover history. A health experience can become a teaching moment. A disagreement can open a conversation about generations, culture or fairness. And a journey across the world can remind us how much our stories intersect.


With roots in the African American experience and branches reaching across cultures and continents, The Diaspora Table creates space for perspectives that may differ—but deserve to be heard.


Some conversations are joyful. Some are difficult. Some are educational. And some are the conversations families have avoided for generations.  Because the stories we inherit matter.  The knowledge we share matters.

NephSpace makes new kidney research easy and fun to follow.

Every week, a practicing nephrologist picks the most interesting new papers and news in nephrology, and two hosts talk them through: the story, the key numbers, why it matters, and an honest take on what the study does and doesn't prove.

Weekly episodes (about 30 minutes) cover that week's picks from the kidney journals, the big general journals and the specialty news. Deep Dives (15 to 20 minutes) follow one question further: two treatments racing for the same goal, a trial worth arguing about, a case that a new paper answers.

Made for nephrologists, nephrology fellows and kidney-care clinicians. Curious, evenhanded, never condescending.

Physician-led, AI-assisted. Dr. Wael Hussein, an academic nephrologist in Memphis, chooses every paper, reviews and edits every script, and approves every episode. First drafts are written with AI from the full text of each paper, a separate AI check compares every number with the papers, and the hosts' voices are AI-generated. Authors' industry ties are named on air, and Dr. Hussein's own disclosures are in every episode's notes.

Educational content for healthcare professionals, not medical advice. Views are the creator's own and not those of his employer. Papers are summarized in our own words, with links to the originals.

Brain Signals is a new webinar and podcast series designed to make neuroregulation more

Through engaging conversations with providers and researchers, the series will explore why

neurotherapy and neuroregulation matter—for personal, clinical, and collective wellbeing. In

addition to chatting with experts, everyday people will share their personal stories of how

neuroregulation has positively changed their lives.


Host David Ims (a licensed mental health counselor and neuroregulation specialist) will highlight

the “why” behind neuroregulation, and the impacts of retraining the brain to sharpen focus, lift

mood, ease worry, balance emotion, or improve sleep.


With the right mixture of data, research, and technology, anyone’s brain signals offer insights

into one’s self-understanding. This can be deployed to strengthen mental resilience and

regulation, complementary of personal background or experiences.


On Brain Signals, you will hear how your neural hardware and mental software interact. If you

have ever wondered how you can gently support your brain to work better in daily life and

improve your mental health and overall wellness, this one is for you. Stay tuned!

description:
Break of Gauge is a novel in three volumes, read aloud one chapter at a time.

Goa, March 1880: a servant runs into a presbytery yard because a newborn is not breathing right, and the padre's boy carries the lamp. Across the subcontinent, in the river towns of Sindh, a railway guard learns the halts of a line he will ride for the rest of his working life. Volume I, The Register, follows two families, one Catholic and Goan, one Hindu and Sindhi, through sixty years of parish registers, railway journals, plague, flood and the freedom movement, until the autumn of 1942, when each house holds a wedding and the war comes down the line.

Built on one family's own records and memories, and on the public history around them. Episodes are released in order; start with the Prelude.

It’s real, reflective, and sometimes ridiculous, just the way Khloé likes it.New episodes drop every Wednesday on YouTube and wherever you get your podcasts.Khloé in Wonder Land is produced by OpenMind, a PAVE Studios’ company, and is distributed by Dear Media.

author: poli
description: Beloved hostess Ina Garten welcomes listeners into her New York City apartment for Happy Hour with Ina Garten. Every Wednesday, she sits down with people she’d like to meet from the worlds of culture, food, art, sports, and entertainment for the kinds of conversations you would love to overhear at a great dinner party. Warm, funny, personal, and often unexpected, Happy Hour mixes in-depth conversation with stories, recipes, and, of course, cocktails. Pull up a chair, pour yourself a drink, and join the conversation.  New episodes drop Wednesdays starting September 16th. Part of the Vox Media Podcast Network.

We discuss the ups and downs, wins and losses, successes and struggles, the good and bad in a respectful but candid way with our guest. We're better than entertainment, we're the REAL thing. Please enjoy the show.

title: Notes from the Edge
author: bhju
description: Notes From the Edge is where polished stories end and the truth begins. Hosted by writer, trauma educator, executive advisor, and author Lisa Lacy, this globally ranked podcast explores survival, identity, trauma, addiction, recovery, leadership, relationships, and reinvention through raw, deeply human conversations. No scripts. No small talk. Just the stories we were taught to hide, the roles we performed to survive, and the truths that set us free. What did you perform in order to survive? Welcome to the edge. www.lisalacy.com

author: Collège MREX
description:
*L'Alliance féminine du Collège MREX : des échanges pour oser et avancer*
Animée par *Audrey Girard* , directrice générale du Collège MREX, et *Émilie Dauphinais-Bertrand* , responsable du succès étudiant, l'Alliance féminine donne la parole à des femmes qui investissent en immobilier. Elles racontent leur parcours, leurs défis et les décisions qui les ont fait progresser.
Des spécialistes du développement personnel s'y joignent aussi pour vous aider à apprivoiser le doute, à dépasser le syndrome de l'imposteur et à prendre confiance en vos capacités.
Des conversations franches entre femmes, des outils concrets et l'élan pour passer du « j'aimerais » au « je me lance »!

title: DigitalSign.co
author: DigitalSign.co
description: Digital signage that earns its screen space. Choosing displays and players, managing content across one location or hundreds, scheduling and dayparting, keeping screens fresh without a full-time designer, and knowing when a screen is down before a customer does. Each episode takes one decision a signage owner is facing — which hardware to standardise on, how often content should change, whether a screen is worth its wall — and works it through practically. Written for operators in retail, restaurants, offices, healthcare and education who are responsible for the screens, not for selling them. Five or six minutes, one topic. Topics include display and player selection, content management and scheduling, multi-location rollouts, dayparting and targeting, data-driven and live content, uptime and remote monitoring, and measuring what a screen actually changes. Produced by DigitalSign.co, digital signage software and hardware solutions. Full details, services and further reading at https://digitalsign.co

title: Translating the Word
author: Ross and Lyndal Webb, Wycliffe Bible Translators Australia
description:
Translating the Word is a podcast hosted by experienced practitioners Ross and Lyndal, offering an 8-minute peek into the world of Bible translation and its place in the world today. With over 7,000 languages spoken globally and millions still lacking scripture in the language they think and dream in, the series explores the urgent mission of making God’s Word understandable to all.
New episodes will drop every Friday morning.

title: The Social Spotlight
author: Catherine Lyon
description:
Welcome to The Social Spotlight Podcast—where we're learning to ditch perfection, embrace who we are, and build communities that actually feel like home.


if you’ve ever caught yourself overthinking every post, holding back from showing up, or stuck in the cycle of trying to "get social media right"—you’re in the right place.


Here, we talk about creating content that truly connects—through storytelling, personality, and tried and true marketing strategies. Whether you're a creator, business owner, or just someone who wants to show up authentically, we’re diving into real, unfiltered conversations on building a brand that stands out—without losing yourself in the process. 


And, of course, making it actually fun.

title: Habits and Hustle
author: cdf
description: Habits and Hustle helps share the stories, habits, and rituals of people's journeys on living fulfilled lives. Host Jennifer Cohen interviews thought leaders, entrepreneurs, and overall extraordinary people who share their insight and open up about the normally hidden aspects that have made a difference in their success.

title: Osgoode Community Chronicles
author: Tracey DAviero
description: I'm Tracey D'Aviero, a 5th generation resident of West Osgoode and Osgoode Village – I am a Blanchfield - and I'll be your host as we explore the stories, events, and people that make our community unique. Each week, we'll dive into the rich history, vibrant local businesses, and exciting events happening in Osgoode and the surrounding areas. Whether you're a lifelong resident or new to the neighborhood, there's something here for everyone.

title: Raheem Android Applications
author: Abdul Raheem
description:
**Android Applications** is a podcast channel where we explore different Android applications, with a special focus on action, entertainment, gaming, and useful mobile apps. We discuss app features, how they work, user experience, updates, and what makes each application interesting.
Whether you enjoy action apps, discover new Android tools, or simply want to learn more about mobile applications, this channel brings you easy-to-understand discussions and helpful information about the Android app world.

title: Dead Air Texas
author: Joshua Tybie
description:
The night the coast went quiet, the power died, the phones died, and the sky went dark over Brazoria County, Texas. The radio didn't.
Every night, Hollis "Holl" Brandt fires up a generator he can't afford to run and signs on at KDXT 1380 — reading water levels, road closures, and the names of the missing to whoever is still listening. He tells stories about the coast that was, and the things that walk the port after dark.
Some nights, when he signs off, something signs back.
Dead Air Texas is a Texas Gothic audio drama about one man, one microphone, and a signal that learned his name.

title: Coffeez with Joe Shalaby
author: Joseph Shalaby
description: Hosted by Joseph Shalaby, Founder and CEO of E Mortgage Capital, this isn’t your typical business podcast. Each episode brings you inside the minds of high-level entrepreneurs, investors, athletes, celebrities, and cultural voices shaping today’s economy — not just what they do, but how they actually win.  From raw origin stories and early struggles to the real mechanics behind how money is made, scaled, and sometimes lost, Joe cuts through the noise to get to what matters. No fluff. No surface-level answers.  Set inside the world of Coffeez, every conversation unfolds with intention — how they started, how they built, what it cost them, and what separates them now.  Whether you're building something, investing in something, or simply trying to understand how the game really works, Coffeez with Joe Shalaby delivers unfiltered insight from people who are actually in it.

title: Story Cafe
author: EverGreen Media Network
description: Join Crystal Canney on "Story Cafe" as she interviews acclaimed authors. Explore their unique writing journeys, their creative inspirations and how their stories came to be. Discover insights on the brilliant minds behind the books you love.

title: Diabetes & Heart Disease: The Clinical Connection
author: American Heart Association
description: The American Heart Association Professional Education Podcast Series focuses on diabetes. Diabetes is one of the major controllable risk factors for cardiovascular disease (CVD). People living with type 2 diabetes are more likely to develop and die from cardiovascular diseases, such as heart attacks, strokes, and heart failure, as well as develop other risk factors such as chronic kidney disease than people who don't have diabetes. Explore this podcast series and raise your awareness and understanding of the link between diabetes and CVD.

title: The World I Live In (A Collection of Essays)
author: Helen Keller
description:
Helen Keller’s powerful journey of perception unfolds in The World I Live In, where she shares her unique insights as a woman who experienced life without sight or sound. Keller invites listeners into her intimate realm, revealing how she navigates the world through touch, smell, and the vibrant landscape of her imagination. Imagine grasping the essence of life through the warmth of a hand or the scent of a flower—Keller brings these experiences to life with remarkable clarity.

At the heart of this audiobook lies the conflict between her physical limitations and her richly textured inner world. Keller's essays explore themes of connection, communication, and the human experience, challenging us to rethink what it means to truly 'see' and 'hear.' As she reflects on her interactions with others and her own thoughts, you’ll discover the profound wisdom she distills from her challenges.

Listeners will find themselves captivated by her passion for understanding and her relentless pursuit of knowledge. Each essay serves as a poignant reminder of the beauty and complexity of existence, urging us to appreciate our senses in new ways. Join Helen Keller on this extraordinary journey and explore the world as she perceives it, sparking curiosity and empathy within us all.

title: Unblinded with Sean Callagy
author: bhyu
description: What if you could see what others don’t—and unlock the hidden patterns that quietly drive every outcome in business, relationships, and life?  Hosted by entrepreneur, attorney, philanthropist, and world-class communicator Sean Callagy, Unblinded is where peak performance meets integrity and possibility. Sean—legally blind since childhood—defied the odds to build multiple eight-figure companies, reinvent industries, and train thousands of leaders in the art of influence. His message is clear: influence is not manipulation, it’s mastery—and when harnessed for good, it transforms everything.

title: Cherokee Cleaning Company - Cleaning
author: Cherokee Cleaning Company
description: Cherokee Cleaning Company - Cleaning Services Knoxville provides professional and dependable commercial cleaning solutions throughout Knoxville, TN. Our experienced team offers a wide range of services designed to keep workplaces clean, healthy, and welcoming. We provide office cleaning, financial institution cleaning, credit union cleaning, bank cleaning, janitorial services, restroom cleaning, floor cleaning, carpet cleaning, deep cleaning, dusting, vacuuming, trash removal, surface disinfection, and commercial facility cleaning. We work with offices, banks, credit unions, businesses, and other commercial facilities, creating customized cleaning plans based on each property's needs. Our team pays close attention to high-traffic areas, frequently touched surfaces, floors, restrooms, and shared spaces to maintain a consistently clean environment.

title: Be Present: The Diane Ray Show
author: Mind Body Spirit.fm
description: The world is full of people with amazing stories. Hear conversations about spirituality, metaphysics, philosophy, mediumship, past lives, reincarnation, health and wellness, yoga, or connecting with the Source within you. Host Diane Ray welcomes a variety of guests sharing powerful information you can apply to your life today.

title: The Learning Leader Show With Ryan Hawk
author: zxs
description: Leaders are learners. The best leaders never stop working to make themselves better. The Learning Leader Show Is series of conversations with the world's most thoughtful leaders.  Entrepreneurs, CEO's, World-Class Athletes, Coaches, Best-Selling Authors, and much more.

title: Faith Over OCD
author: Brianna Brinker
description: Faith Over OCD is a Christian podcast about navigating intrusive thoughts and the struggles of the mind while growing closer to Jesus Christ. Through personal stories, faith-based encouragement, and honest conversations, this podcast reminds listeners that they are not alone and can turn to Jesus in the midst of their struggles.

title: This American Life
author: gtyh
description: Each week we choose a theme. Then anything can happen. This American Life is true stories that unfold like little movies for radio. Personal stories with funny moments, big feelings, and surprising plot twists. Newsy stories that try to capture what it’s like to be alive right now. It’s the most popular weekly podcast in the world, and winner of the first ever Pulitzer Prize for a radio show or podcast. Hosted by Ira Glass and produced in collaboration with WBEZ Chicago.

title: She Don’t Work Like That No More
author: Norlander Wilson
description:
They called you difficult. You were paying attention.
She Don’t Work Like That No More™ is the conversation people have after the meeting, out loud. Host Norlander Wilson, a behavioral operations strategist, talks with coaches, HR leaders, attorneys, and founders about what’s really happening at work: toxic management, retaliation, burnout, being labeled “difficult,” and deciding whether to stay, shift, or go.
No corporate translation required.
New episodes every other Sunday. Get the receipts (scripts, frameworks, and free workplace tools) at bikomeye.com.

title: More Like Us
author: More Equitable Democracy
description:
More Like Us is a candid, humor-laced conversation series that invites everyday Americans to stop patching a broken democracy and start imagining a better one.

Hosted by Colin Cole, each episode features a frank, funny, and occasionally reality-checking conversation with an election expert, voting rights advocate, or culture-shaping celebrity or influencer to reimagine American democracy.

title: In The Dark
author: ñopl
description: In the Dark, hosted by Madeleine Baran, is an award-winning investigative-journalism podcast that started in 2016. Its first season looked at the mysterious abduction of Jacob Wetterling in rural Minnesota and the lack of accountability that sheriffs face when they fail to solve cases. Season 2 examined the case of Curtis Flowers, who was tried six times for the same crime. In 2020, In the Dark released a special report on the coronavirus pandemic in the Mississippi Delta. In 2023, In the Dark joined The New Yorker and in 2024, it released “The Runaway Princesses,” a four-part series that asks why the women in Dubai’s royal family keep trying to run away. Season 3, released in 2024, asked why no one was punished for the killings of twenty-five civilians in Haditha, Iraq.  In the Dark won the Pulitzer Prize for audio for Season 3. The podcast is a three-time Peabody Award winner and, in 2019, became the first podcast to win a George Polk Award, one of the top honors in journalism. The program has also received an Alfred I. duPont-Columbia University Award and a Robert F. Kennedy Journalism Award.  New Yorker subscribers get early, ad-free access. In Apple Podcasts, tap the link at the top of the feed to subscribe or link an existing subscription. Or visit newyorker.com/dark to subscribe and listen in the New Yorker app.  If you have comments or story tips, please send them to inthedark@newyorker.com.

title: Aging Amazing: the Podcast
author: Andrew Graft
description: Aging Amazing is where practical guidance meets a more positive view of growing older. Host Andrew Graft, resident aging expert Alan Ormsby, and knowledgeable guests help older adults and the people who love them make sense of the choices, challenges, and opportunities that come with aging. From health, caregiving, safety, and independence to purpose, connection, and everyday life, the show offers clear, respectful conversations that help you move forward with greater confidence, dignity, and hope.

title: Mick Unplugged
author: gtyu
description: Everybody talks about your WHY. Mick Hunt goes deeper.  Mick Unplugged is the leadership and personal growth podcast built on one idea: your BECAUSE is the purpose underneath your purpose, and it is the most powerful force you own. Hosted by Mick Hunt, USA Today bestselling author and the voice of Modern Leadership, every episode sits across from a high performer, founder, athlete, or culture-shaper and asks the one question they cannot fake an answer to. What is your BECAUSE?  Past guests include Shark Tank stars Daymond John and Kevin O'Leary, entrepreneur Gary Vaynerchuk, motivational legend Les Brown, Chef Robert Irvine, comedians Rickey Smiley and Earthquake, NFL Hall of Famer Jared Allen, hospitality mogul David Grutman, and World Series champion Jeremy Guthrie. No scripts. No surface-level fluff. Just the real fire behind why they refused to quit.  If you are a leader, an entrepreneur, or someone who is done coasting on motivational quotes, this is your show. You will walk away every week with mindset shifts, leadership strategy, and the kind of straight talk that actually moves you forward.  New episodes drop weekly. Follow Mick Unplugged on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and YouTube so you never miss one.  Your BECAUSE is your Superpower. Go Unleash It.

description: Function Over Fix is a health and wellness podcast focused on functional medicine, root-cause health, nutrition, gut health, hormones, inflammation, and chronic illness. Each episode breaks down complex health topics and challenges the idea that managing symptoms is the same as getting healthy. If you want to better understand why your body is struggling and what actually influences long-term health, this show is for you. When you stop blindly listening and start asking why, everything changes.

title: The Unseen Athlete

description: A podcast for female college athletes that explores the parts of being an athlete that people don’t always see, including pressure, injuries, identity, academics, and life outside of sports. It gives athletes a space to feel understood and recognize that they are more than just their sport.

Dylan is on a mission to bring the TRUTH to all of his listeners and subscribers on everything health and fitness related.  Sit back, relax and be prepared to get educated on THE FACTS, without bias, on how to consistently fix and improve your quality of life, happiness and well being!!  THE MISSION of this podcast is ensure that all listeners get the TRUTH and GUIDANCE necessary to overcome all adversities and to be inspired to take control of your lives! Dylan is the creator of the Dylan Gemelli Podcast, which features enlightening discussions with some of the most prominent experts and influencers in the health and wellness space, best selling authors, top cardiologists, neuroscientists and more!! sick lit girl is a leftist literary podcast hosted by former psychodynamic psychotherapist Nina Lalić. Episodes feature writers, musicians, and other artists, alongside solo reflections on culture, psychoanalytic theory, creative life, and the art of living with chronic illness and pain. Personal, connecting, and a little irreverent. For anyone longing for real intimacy in a fractured world.


Note that certain readings will appear on the Patreon only, as will particular personal episodes/additional content.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Up First from NPR
author: retf
description:
NPR's Up First is the news you need to start your day. The three biggest stories of the day, with reporting and analysis from NPR News — in 10 minutes. Available weekdays at 6:30 a.m. ET, with hosts Leila Fadel, Steve Inskeep, Michel Martin and A Martinez. Also available on Saturdays at 9 a.m. ET, with Ayesha Rascoe and Scott Simon. On Sundays, hear a longer exploration behind the headlines with Ayesha Rascoe on "The Sunday Story," available by 8 a.m. ET. Subscribe and listen, then support your local NPR station at donate.npr.org.

Support public media by joining NPR+ at plus.npr.org. You’ll get perks for over 25 NPR podcasts, including sponsor-free listening for Up First, NPR News Now, and more.

title: Running on Empty(ish)
author: Emily
description: Running on Empty(ish) is a podcast about anxiety, communication, and surviving a busy life without pretending you have it all figured out. No fake positivity- just honest conversations for anyone tired of saying "I'm fine" when they're not.

title: Cockpit Attack | Terror at 34,000 Feet
author: Caloroga Media
description:
A co-pilot stabs his captain at 34,000 feet. The plane plunges toward the earth. And 174 people have seconds to decide who they are. Cockpit Attack: Terror at 34,000 Feet is a five-part dramatized thriller inspired by the September 30, 2026 cockpit attack aboard a Dubai-to-Tel Aviv flight. The real flight dropped 14,000 feet in seconds, lost most of its rudder, and landed safely only after passengers stormed the cockpit. Follow a captain fighting for his life with his daughter's drawing folded over his heart. Follow a quiet first officer whose last morning holds secrets no one saw coming. And follow the strangers in the cabin who refuse to die: a plumber, a dentist, a young mother, and a man in seat 3C who notices everything. Their story has a locked door, a desperate mayday, a crippled jet with nowhere to land, and one question that haunts it all: why? Five episodes. One a day. Told by a single storyteller, minute by minute, from pushback to touchdown.

Inspired by recent events. All names, characters, and many details are fictional and dramatized. This series is not a factual account.

title: A Very Very Different World Podcast
author: Crystal DeVone
description: A Very, Very Different World is where HBCU culture, nostalgia, and real life meet.  Hosted by Howard University alum, DJ, storyteller, and experience curator **C. DeVone**, the podcast revisits the moments that made *A Different World* iconic while exploring what HBCU life really looked like then—and what it looks like now.  From friendships, dating and campus culture to music, career, identity and the unforgettable stories we probably shouldn’t tell—but will—C. DeVone brings together alumni, friends and special guests for honest conversations with plenty of laughs.  And with a new generation heading to Hillman, we’re talking about that too.  Because the world may be different, but the culture, the stories and the memories still connect us.  Welcome to A Very, Very Different World.

title: DreamNudge The Goal Setting Club
author: Amy Jans
description: DreamNudge Goal Setting Club is a podcast about making going after what you want way more fun. Hosted by Amy Jans, each episode feels like a real club meeting where we talk about creativity, ambition, procrastination, changing your mind, getting stuck, and figuring out what you actually want. Expect DreamNudge exercises, short visualizations, affirmations, check-ins, and one small weekly Nudge. No perfect routines or pretending anyone has it all figured out. Just dream, laugh, regroup, and keep going.

title: Trinity Lutheran Church Sermon Podcast
author: Trinity Lutheran Church, Tinley Park Illinois
description:
Join with us as we worship God, learning more about Him, and growing in His love for us! This podcast features sermons from our weekly worship services, shared by Trinity Lutheran's Senior Pastor, Paul Strand and Associate Pastor, Rick Schauer.


Trinity Lutheran Church is an LCMS congregation, located southwest of Chicago in Tinley Park, IL. Trinity was founded in 1859 and has been an active church and parochial school since its inception over 165 years ago.

title: The Pickleball Talks
author: The Pickleball Talks
description:
Welcome to The Pickleball Talks - a podcast of the Interact Pickleball Network - where  the one simple truth is...the point is never more important than the person. Every day you wake up, lift your head off the pillow, take your first breath, put your feet on the floor. That is a reset. And so is every moment you step to the service line for a new match. Every serve is a reset. Every point is a choice. 

Here everyone belongs. And here you'll get every tool you need from spiritual guidance to medical experts to nutrition and total wellness. Like a spinning spice rack of life ingredients you can choose from to reset, rebuild, and return to the person you used to be. 

This is The Pickleball Talks.

title: Locals Only Podcast
author: The Augusta Guy- M. Austin Jackson
description:
There’s more to Augusta than what you see on the surface.
Hosted by Austin Jackson, “The Augusta Guy,” Locals Only brings you conversations with the people who have helped shape the CSRA. From business owners and community leaders to public figures and visionaries, we’ll explore the stories behind the people, places, and ideas that make this community so special.
We’ll talk business, growth, culture, challenges, successes, and everything in between.
Because every city has a story. These are the people writing ours.

title: AI Trans

description: Transcend AI is your trusted guide to the world of AI technologies impacting transgender lives. Each episode reviews the latest tools, resources, and conversations at the intersection of AI and trans identity. Stay informed, empowered, and connected with expert insights and honest guides.

title: Safer Skies
author: Boeing Center for Aviation & Aerospace Safety
description:
This new production—produced by Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University and the Boeing Center for Aviation and Aerospace Safety—takes listeners and viewers into the heart of aviation and aerospace, revealing the people, innovations and practices that shape our industry’s rigorous safety standards.
Join us for exclusive behind-the-scenes perspectives with leading experts, researchers and personalities. Hosted by the Honorable Robert Sumwalt, each episode is your front-row seat to the industry’s relentless efforts to ensure the safety of all who fly.

title: Jack Hibbs sermon
author: Kudos
description:
Join Pastor Jack Hibbs for powerful, Bible-centered conversations that explore faith, Scripture, current issues, and what it means to follow Jesus Christ in today’s world. With a strong emphasis on biblical truth and practical Christian living, each episode offers encouragement, teaching, and thoughtful insights designed to strengthen your walk with God.
Whether you’re seeking deeper understanding of Scripture, answers to life’s challenges, or encouragement in your faith, this podcast points listeners back to the Word of God and the hope found in Jesus Christ.

title: A Shot of Whiskey- Travel, Work, Sex, and Everything Life Pours Your Way.
author: Linda Rogers
description:
Welcome to A Shot of Whiskey-because sometimes life calls for a laugh... and sometimes it calls for something stronger.

I'm Whiskey, and every week we're taking a shot at whatever life throws our way-travel disasters, career changes, healthcare headaches, dating, sex, wild stories, embarrassing moments, and all the plot twist nobody warned us about.

This isn't a self-help podcast. it's a survival podcast-with sarcasm, questionable life choices, plenty of laughs, and the occasional pearl of wisdom we accidentally stumble upon. 

So, pour yourself a drink (or grab a coffee-we don't judge), pull up a chair, and join the conversation. because if we can't laugh at life's chaos, we're probably crying in the grocery store parking lot. 

Real stories. Real opinions. Zero filters. Just a Shot of Whiskey.

title: Story Pirates
author: tresder
description: The award-winning Story Pirates Podcast takes stories written by kids and turns them into sketch comedy and songs. Made up of talented comedians, songwriters, and frequent celebrity guests, the Story Pirates inspire kids to create, bringing laughter to kids and grownups of all ages with hilarious sketches, catchy original songs from all genres, and interviews with the creative geniuses behind the stories… kids!  Sales and Distribution by Lemonada Media https://lemonadamedia.com/

title: The Leap with Michael DelVecchio

title: Liftoff Journeys with Jeanniey Walden
author: Jeanniey Walden
description:
Liftoff Journeys isn’t about polished success stories.
It’s about the moments before success makes sense.

It was inspired by my three-year-old who told me, “I want to be a bubble bather when I grow up."   I realized that what she saw was that a bubble bath created joy, helped people, and made others feel good.

Her instinct to do this in every roles she has had never disappeared. This moment revealed something powerful to me: it’s the moments before success that shape who we become.

Hosted by Jeanniey Walden, Liftoff Journeys features honest conversations with leaders, founders, and executives about how they actually built their lives and careers, through real decisions, detours, doubts, and defining moments.
  • No bios.
  • No highlight reels.
Just authentic choices, inspired action, and relatable human experience.

At its core, the show reflects the mission of Liftoff Enterprises: helping leaders grow with confidence, clarity, and trust — in themselves and with others.

These conversations echo the ideas behind The Trust Threshold: the point where self-doubt turns into momentum and leadership shifts from performance to presence.There’s no single path to growth, but there are patterns.If you’ve ever wondered what happens before it all clicks, this podcast is for you.

This is Liftoff Journeys.

Join us for 31 days of fun and educational Halloween facts, exploring the traditions, history, legends, customs, and curious Halloween connections found across the globe. From the familiar Halloween celebrations of North America to the fascinating festivals, ancient traditions, and spooky customs of countries around the world, discover how different cultures celebrate, remember, and embrace the mysterious side of the season.

And because Halloween should always come with a little laughter, every episode also delivers a daily Halloween joke to tickle your funny bone, even if you’re already shaking in your boots!

author: Andrea Glovsky
description:
Helping People Learn, Grow & Flourish—from 5 to 95 

| Educational Psychologist • Educator • Speaker • Founder & Host, The Wise Old Owl

My life’s work has never been simply about education. It has been about enhancing the human experience—and developing the knowledge, curiosity, confidence, and resilience we need to live meaningful lives.

Over more than fifty years and five careers, primarily in education, I’ve taught students from second grade through college, worked as an educational psychologist, developed programs for corporations, lectured on educational issues, and helped students and families find the educational paths that fit them best.

Across every chapter of my career, one purpose has remained constant: helping people recognize their possibilities, continue learning, and become their best selves. Many of the people I’ve worked with still remember that—and many remain in my life today.

That work isn’t finished. It has simply found a new forum.

Through The Wise Old Owl, I bring a lifetime of experience to the opportunities and challenges we face today. From typewriters to TikTok to artificial intelligence, our world has changed in ways we could never have imagined. Together, we’ll look beyond what is merely new and ask what truly helps us learn, grow, and flourish. What should we embrace? What must we preserve? And what will always make us deeply human?

I’m still learning, and I’m not done asking questions. Whatever your age, I invite you to continue the journey with me.

title: Architect the Future
author: BCG Platinion
description:
How will AI reshape the enterprise of the future? From scanning items at the grocery store to routing airplanes across the globe — technology is the central nervous system of our world. Now, enterprise AI is rewriting how those systems think: finding patterns, making connections, and reshaping how enterprises operate at a scale we've never seen before. 
Architect the Future brings the enterprise perspective to the AI conversation. Each episode features leaders at the forefront of AI adoption and explores how the technology is transforming business. Across industries, we examine the decisions, systems, and designs shaping the next era of enterprise AI.
What will value creation look like in this new landscape? How can businesses increase quality and efficiency while still prioritizing responsible AI governance? And what does it mean to lead in a time of such big transformation? Architect the Future explores how organizations can navigate rapid AI-driven change with intention and a focus on what’s next. Because the future doesn’t simply happen to us. We build it.
About our Host:
David Heurtaux is a Principal AI Tech Architect at BCG Platinion in our London office. Since joining in 2022, he has focused on cloud architecture and (Gen)AI platforms, combining deep expertise in software engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, and AI strategy.
With experience in IT Architecture, David is part of BCG’s (Gen)AI Platforms Group and serves as a BCG Global GenAI Blackbelt. He specializes in cloud-based microservice architectures for AI, data, and digital platforms, and brings strong experience in design thinking, DevOps, and agile methodologies.
About BCG Platinion:
BCG Platinion is BCG's specialized tech experts and part of their tech and digital practice.
BCG Platinion delivers end-to-end solutions that transform how our clients work and compete. By embedding advanced technologies spanning cloud, data, AI, and GenAI into core business processes, we empower organizations to accelerate their digital ambitions. Our approach blends strategic excellence with deep technical rigor to unlock sustainable growth and purpose.
BCG Platinion helps clients turn ambitious technology transformations into reality by integrating and managing custom-fit, large-scale architectures that deliver measurable, purpose-driven impact.

Want to learn more about how BCG Platinion is working with enterprises to embrace the future with AI? Have an idea for a guest you’d love to hear on our show? Or do you have feedback to share about a recent episode? Get in touch at podcasts@bcgplatinion.com.

title: Surprise House (Aunt Nan's Mysterious Gifts)
author: Abbie Farwell Brown
description:
When Dr. Owen Corliss inherits his eccentric Aunt Nan's peculiar house, he quickly discovers it’s more than just a family estate. With his wife and two children, Mary and John, he steps into a world filled with whimsical surprises, practical jokes, and riddles inspired by Shakespeare’s poetry. Each room holds secrets waiting to be uncovered, but the real mystery lies in Aunt Nan’s intentions. Why did she leave these curious clues? What truths about the family will they reveal? As the Corliss family navigates their new home, they find themselves on a treasure hunt that tests their bonds and challenges their perceptions of love, legacy, and laughter.

Join Owen, Mary, and John in "Surprise House" as they unravel the mysteries of the past while creating memories for the future. Each discovery leads them deeper into Aunt Nan’s enchanting world, where every corner might spark a new adventure or a heartfelt revelation. This audiobook invites listeners to embrace curiosity and the joy of family togetherness, all wrapped in a delightful blend of humor and intrigue. Perfect for listeners of all ages, prepare to be captivated by the unexpected twists that await in this charming tale of exploration, family, and the magic of a home filled with surprises.

title: AI and Autism
author: Autistic Culture Podcast Network
description:
AI and Autism explores what happens when artificial intelligence meets neurodivergent life.


Hosted by writer and AI strategist Bre Ransome, MA, this series brings together neurodivergent creators, thinkers and AI users from around the world to explore how artificial intelligence is becoming part of how we work, communicate, create and understand ourselves.


Across the series, Bre and her guests discuss using AI to navigate executive dysfunction, process thoughts and emotions, explore complex relationship dynamics and create new forms of cognitive support. Along the way, they consider not only what these technologies can make possible for neurodivergent people, but the questions, limitations and complications that come with them.


Whether you're an AI super-user, just beginning to experiment with it, or deeply sceptical about where this technology is taking us, AI and Autism is a space for neurodivergent people to work through the ways AI is changing our lives.


Connect with Bre:

  • Subscribe to ai.tism — Bre's Substack exploring AI, neurodivergence and the ways she uses AI as an accessibility tool.
  • Get in touch with Bre — share your experiences with AI, tell Bre what you're experimenting with, or express your interest in joining AI and Autism as a guest.


🎧 AI and Autism is available on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and all major platforms.

🌈 Celebrate autistic voices with early access, ad-free listening, and our full archive at AutisticCulturePlus.com

🌐 Visit www.autisticculturepodcastnetwork.com

description:

This podcast helps you understand what may actually be causing your symptoms, when physical therapy, injections, or time may be enough, and when spine surgery starts making sense.


Dr. Leonard Kibuule covers herniated discs, sciatica, spinal stenosis, cervical myelopathy, minimally invasive spine surgery, microdiscectomy, spinal fusion, artificial disc replacement, second opinions, and spine surgery recovery.


The goal is simple: help you understand your options and get back to walking, working, exercising, traveling, and living normally again.

title: Meteor
author: Md Shahidul Islam
description:
Meteor tells the true stories of cosmic impacts and the rocks that fall from space. Each episode, host Nirob takes one event — the meteor storm that set the sky on fire in 1833, the blast over the Siberian forest in 1908, the meteorite that crashed through a car in 1992, the comet that fell on Jupiter before the eyes of the world, the impact that ended the age of the dinosaurs — and rebuilds it: the moment of the fall, the witnesses who saw it, the search for the rock and the crater, the science that read the evidence, and what the event taught us about the danger from the sky.

From the meteorites worshipped in the ancient world to the craters of the deep past, from the fireballs that light up the modern sky to the planetary defence that is tracking the asteroids of the future, Meteor is the story of the solar system reaching down to touch the Earth. Meticulously researched, clear about the astronomy and the geology, and honest about the difference between the legend of a falling star and the science of a falling rock. Clean and suitable for all ages. A new fall every week

title: Life & Work in Saudi Arabia
author: Liam Parker
description:
Life and Work in Saudi Arabia is an informative podcast series created for expatriate workers, residents, employees, employers, and anyone navigating the practical side of working and living in the Kingdom. The series explores everyday topics connected with employment, residency, visas, travel permissions, workplace documentation, salary-related matters, and end-of-service planning.Each episode breaks down complicated administrative subjects into clear, practical conversations. Listeners can learn about the documents they may need, the importance of checking official records, how different government platforms serve different purposes, and why keeping track of important dates can make employment and travel planning easier.

One particularly useful topic is understanding how to confirm the status of a Saudi visa before making travel or employment plans. For listeners researching the muqeem visa validity check, the series can explain what information may appear in a Muqeem result, how visa status and expiry dates should be interpreted, and why users should enter sensitive identification details only through the appropriate official government service.The podcast does not replace official government services or professional immigration advice.

Instead, its objective is to help listeners understand the terminology, processes, and practical considerations involved in Saudi employment and residency administration so they can approach official services with greater confidence.Future episodes can cover exit and re-entry visas, final exit procedures, residency documentation, visa expiry dates, employment records, end-of-service benefits, workplace transitions, and the importance of maintaining accurate personal records.Series objectives:
  • Explain Saudi employment and residency processes in accessible language.
  • Help expatriate workers understand common visa and residency terminology.
  • Encourage listeners to verify important information through official government channels.
  • Discuss practical preparation for employment transitions and end-of-service situations.
  • Highlight the importance of checking dates, statuses, and official records before making travel or employment decisions.
  • Provide educational discussions that complement, rather than replace, official government guidance.
